subject: bulgarian
summary: Cyrillic renders correctly everywhere and the attached reading text is the right one for each card, sharp and uncluttered. Short vocabulary cards work, apart from the word to be explained being run onto the end of the instruction with nothing to set it off. The essay and commentary cards are where it falls down: the scheme area is filled with small grey paragraphs of commentary about the scheme itself ('The paper prints the rule on page 2...', 'The fourth criterion prints no percentage, so...') with the real criteria and their 30% weightings buried inside quotation marks, and one essay card says 'The scheme prints no answer for this part' under the heading 'Select the points you actually got' followed by a 0-40 number grid. The commentary card is a very long wall of text on a phone. Desktop is tidier only because the lines are wider.

issues.title: Grey commentary about the scheme crowds out the scheme
issues.detail: Essay/commentary cards open the scheme with a long small-print paragraph in mixed English and Bulgarian describing what the scheme document prints ('Under the two titles the scheme prints “...”. It then prints, with no marks or percentages beside the criteria: “...”. It reprints the instruction as “...”'). On card 5 the four marking criteria and their 30% weightings are flattened into this paragraph as quoted run-on text (“1. ... – 30% ;” “2. ... – 30% ;”). It sits inside the first tick box, above the first real point.
issues.suggested_fix: Delete the meta-commentary. Show the four criteria as a small table (criterion, weighting) once, then the content guidance as separate points.

issues.title: 'No answer' essay card looks broken
issues.detail: Card 3's scheme says 'The scheme prints no answer for this part.' under the heading 'Select the points you actually got', then a grey paragraph, then a grid of buttons 0 to 40. The four marking criteria that card 4 lists are not shown here, and the footer strip repeats 'The scheme prints no answer for this part.'
issues.suggested_fix: Show the same four criteria card 4 shows, change the heading to 'Mark yourself against the criteria', and replace the 41-button grid with a slider or banded choice.

issues.title: Commentary scheme is a wall of text
issues.detail: Card 5 has three tick boxes each holding a full paragraph of examiner prose (up to 15 lines on a phone), plus the grey preamble; no marks per box. On the phone it runs to more than two full columns.
issues.suggested_fix: Break each paragraph into short bullet ideas; lead with the heading the scheme gives it.

issues.title: Term to explain is not set off from the instruction
issues.detail: Cards 1 and 2 read '...в текста? очевидна достоверност' and '...в текста? доверие' as one sentence; the word being asked about is in the same type as the instruction. Card 2 says 'the underlined words' while the paper shows them in bold.
issues.suggested_fix: Put the term on its own line in bold or quotes.

issues.title: Language-rule note repeated under every answer
issues.detail: 'The examination requires every answer in BULGARIAN. The paper prints the rule on page 2: "..."' appears under each scheme answer and again in the attachment footer (truncated with '...'). It is longer than the 1-mark answer it sits under.
issues.suggested_fix: Show once per subject, not per card.

issues.title: Essay rubric says 'one of the following topics' but shows one
issues.detail: Cards 3 and 4 keep the paper's 'on one of the following topics:' then show a single title, with the author attribution trailing after a stray hyphen on card 4 ('.” - Иван Тургенев').
issues.suggested_fix: Reword to 'Essay title:' and set the quotation and author on separate lines.

good_examples.why: Short vocabulary card: one-line answer, correct reading text attached and legible.
The four numbered criteria (rows 2-4 especially) show how essay schemes should look once the grey preamble is removed.
